lines.text: Isaiah praises the LORD for wonders planned long ago, and a strong people will honor Him.
God has been a refuge for the poor and needy, and the song of the ruthless is silenced.
On this mountain the LORD of Hosts will prepare a lavish banquet for all the peoples.
The LORD will swallow up the shroud over all nations and death forever, and wipe away sweat from every face.
Edom will be trampled, his pride will be brought low, and the high-walled fortress will fall into the dust.
